verification.current_defect_probes: Existing synthetic/PGlite and actual disposable PostgreSQL concurrency probes rerun at current code revision. Additional pure-memory conversation, jsdom audio and PGlite reminder reproductions completed. No production database opened by these defect probes.

bugs.title: Legacy care command survives session revocation while waiting for the participant lock
bugs.reproduction: Hold profile FOR UPDATE; start an authenticated check-in command; revoke its session while it waits; release lock. Actual PostgreSQL committed the command and one receipt after revocation.
bugs.next: Unify mutation authority locking/revalidation across legacy care methods; test session, account and grant revocation and lock ordering before enabling connector writes.

repair.change: Recheck session, account and role-grant authority after the participant lock, holding shared authority locks through legacy mutations.
repair.verification: Actual PostgreSQL and running portal HTTP lock-wait/revocation probes denied the command with no receipt.

bugs.title: Grocery mutation retains stale family-sharing permission across a lock wait
bugs.reproduction: Family grocery command reads allowed sharing, waits for profile lock; client revokes sharing; releasing lock still commits addition. Subsequent read is denied. Reproduced on actual isolated PostgreSQL.
bugs.next: Serialize sharing changes with mutation authorization, then recheck the actual sharing rows under the correct lock order.

repair.change: Re-read family grocery sharing after the participant lock before permitting a mutation.
repair.verification: Actual PostgreSQL and running portal HTTP sharing-revocation race denied the edit with no receipt.

bugs.title: Device queue dispatches after deactivation during the storage wait
bugs.reproduction: Pause storage write for unknown status, deactivate queue, release storage. One transport dispatch occurs despite deactivation.
bugs.next: Recheck epoch/scope after every awaited preparation and immediately before dispatch; cover submit and retry paths.

repair.change: Recheck active scope/epoch after awaited device-storage preparation and before dispatch.
repair.verification: Browser touch save and receipt failed before commit; pending status stayed honest. Logout cleared the device queue; relogin did not replay and actual PostgreSQL confirmed no activity. The exact paused-storage interleaving is automated, not claimed as a physical-device reproduction.

bugs.title: Historical appointment cap removes imminent appointments from context
bugs.reproduction: Seed 200 historical appointments plus one appointment in an hour. The oldest-first 200-row cap excludes the imminent record from today and priority suggestions; reproduced in PGlite.
bugs.next: Bound current/upcoming appointments separately from history and expose truncation honestly; preserve historical reporting identities.

repair.change: Prefer current/upcoming appointments over history in bounded context; expose total/omitted counts.
repair.verification: Running portal HTTP plus browser My Day retained the imminent record with 200 older synthetic appointments; truncation was explicit.

bugs.title: Unconfirmed spoken activity save loses the command and receipt key
bugs.reproduction: Prepare and play a meal review, confirm, fail command and immediate receipt lookup with 503. Original turn retry gives turn_unconfirmed; a new turn invokes the model without the original receipt key. One receipt lookup total; no pending activity remains. Pure-memory reproduction.
bugs.next: Retain unresolved activity identity and reconcile before another write, including reload/server restart. Duplicate care entries are a risk, not a reproduced database outcome.

repair.change: Durably retain the confirmed command and scope before dispatch; reconcile its receipt before model use or another report. Explicit retries reuse that exact command. Changed turn payloads remain rejected; definite retry rejection clears the intent.
repair.verification: Real owner-bound Sol/high prepared a synthetic meal; actual Heart audio was acknowledged. Lost response and receipt lookup were recovered after actual API restart. Missing receipt required explicit same-key retry. Browser reload reconciled one saved entry; final restarted HTTP probe verified changed-turn and definite-rejection boundaries.

bugs.title: Authorization failure fetching speech resumes listening instead of clearing the session
bugs.reproduction: Complete greeting and reply, then return 401 for speech fetch. jsdom/fake-audio probe ends listening with zero authorization events, zero microphone stops and zero conversation-end calls before cleanup.
bugs.next: Route speech 401 and scope_changed 403 through shared authorization cleanup and stop recording immediately. No unauthorized server write was demonstrated.

repair.change: Speech GET 401 and scope_changed 403 use shared authorization cleanup; voice immediately stops microphone/audio and cannot resume listening.
repair.verification: Running browser received injected speech 401/403 from the real portal: sign-in or scope refresh appeared, generated native MediaStreamTrack ended and listening did not resume.

bugs.title: Reminder scheduling ignores an appointment's effective rescheduled time
bugs.reproduction: At 09:30 participant time, move a 10:00 appointment to 11:00 through the activity command. PGlite persisted the reschedule but claimed a 09:30 prompt announcing 10:00. Routine conflict queries also read original appointment times; that extension needs its own test.
bugs.next: Use the same effective occurrence schedule as My Day for reminders and protected-time conflicts; test changed, deferred and completed records and stale prompt invalidation.

repair.change: Use an effective occurrence projection for appointment reminders and protected program conflicts. Meal prompt versions include effective due times and respect deferral/completion.
repair.verification: Running portal HTTP invalidated the old appointment claim and used the changed due time. Browser showed the effective appointment schedule. Meal, deferral/completion and protected conflict regressions passed in PGlite; full DST/three-genuine-date prompt matrix remains open.

bugs.title: Program rest expiry does not refresh next-step controls
bugs.observation: Eligibility is fetched on mount/scope change or mutation only. A rest-blocked run hides reporting controls, with no timer/poll/manual refresh to observe rest completion.
bugs.next: Add fake-clock UI reproduction; refresh from server at the rest boundary without requiring reload and without retaining stale scope.

repair.change: Expose rest_until and refresh server guidance automatically at its boundary, with scoped cleanup and bounded retry; add manual refresh.
repair.verification: Actual browser/portal/PostgreSQL one-minute rest expired and next-step controls appeared without reload or manual refresh.

bugs.title: Program conflicts display browser-local rather than participant-local time
bugs.observation: Both conflict lists call toLocaleTimeString without the participant time_zone even though workspace supplies it.
bugs.next: Add different-browser-zone UI test and format using workspace.time_zone.

repair.change: Format both program conflict lists in workspace.time_zone and label the zone.
repair.verification: Browser displayed America/Vancouver 1:32 p.m. before and after routine start while the host/browser used America/Toronto.
